image.name: syslog-ng
image.description: [syslog-ng](https://www.syslog-ng.com/products/open-source-log-management/) allows you to flexibly collect, parse, classify, rewrite and correlate logs from across your infrastructure and store or route them to log analysis tools.

changelog.desc: Add opt to log to stdout.
Add paho-mqtt-c library as required by the syslog-ng documentation
Rebase to Alpine 3.17, add libdbi-drivers for SQL support.
Rebase to Alpine 3.16, migrate to s6v3.

env_vars.name: LOG_TO_STDOUT
env_vars.desc: If set to `true` container will log to stdout, otherwise will log to `/config/log/`.

volumes.desc: Stores logs collected by the syslog-ng service

image.title: Syslog-ng
image.setup_instructions:
Edit `/config/syslog-ng.conf` to configure your logging sources and destinations.

The application pid, control file, etc. are all kept in /config so when using tools such as `syslog-ng-ctl` you need to specify the path e.g. `syslog-ng-ctl reload -c /config/syslog-ng.ctl`

More info at [syslog-ng](https://www.syslog-ng.com/technical-documents/list/syslog-ng-open-source-edition).

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  syslog-ng:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/syslog-ng:latest
    container_name: syslog-ng
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - LOG_TO_STDOUT= #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/syslog-ng/config:/config
      - /path/to/log:/var/log #optional
    ports:
      - 514:5514/udp
      - 601:6601/tcp
      - 6514:6514/tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=syslog-ng \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e LOG_TO_STDOUT= `#optional` \
  -p 514:5514/udp \
  -p 601:6601/tcp \
  -p 6514:6514/tcp \
  -v /path/to/syslog-ng/config:/config \
  -v /path/to/log:/var/log `#optional` \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/syslog-ng:latest
